$comment: Part I Section B — form-structure lens for the contracting authority. Fields follow the Schematron-mandated minimum; `required` reflects the rule severity (fatal -> required, warning -> optional).
title: Identity of the procurer
description: Identify the contracting authority or contracting entity running this procurement procedure.

fields.label: Official name
fields.description: Official name of the contracting authority or contracting entity (BR-REQ-20-02, fatal).

fields.label: Country
fields.description: Country of the contracting authority (BR-REQ-20-03, fatal).

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: Party identifier value. Recommended but not fatal (BR-REQ-20-04, warning).

fields.label: Identifier type
fields.description: The type of identifier (NATIONAL, LEI, BRIS, DUNS, VAT) — the EOIDType codelist. Shown alongside the identifier so the user can pick the type and enter the value together. The XML @schemeAgencyID (BR-OTH-02) is DERIVED from this type at export (VAT→VIES, …; OP otherwise), so there is no separate scheme-agency field.
